directlyMappedSources.context: Q4.3 Kernphysik, erhöhtes Niveau (Leistungskurs), Zerfallsgesetze sub-bullet Zerfallsreihen
directlyMappedSources.supports: The content topic decay chains, nested within decay laws.
directlyMappedSources.doesNotExplicitlyRequire: Coupled parent-daughter differential equations, time-dependent daughter activity, a Bateman solution, or radioactive equilibrium. The short topic permits interpretation, but does not uniquely mandate any such advanced implementation.
directlyMappedSources.legacyCaveat: The old authored HE snapshot's phrase 'qualitativ diskutieren und berechnen' is not an additional official clause.

directlyMappedSources.actualReading: Official live Ph13 4.1 Ein einfaches Kernmodell, erhöhtes Anforderungsniveau, competence on digital nuclide charts and content list; 2026-09-07.
directlyMappedSources.supports: Extracting nuclide and decay-chain properties from digital charts.
directlyMappedSources.doesNotExplicitlyRequire: Coupled time evolution of parent and daughter populations. The separate decay-law derivation topic cannot simply be copied into this mapped chart clause.

directlyMappedSources.metadataCaveat: The retained extraction paraphrases this as qualitative description; the actual PDF is more concrete about building a chain using the periodic table. The proposal relies on the actual source wording, not that weakened paraphrase.

sourceConclusion.supported: A structurally correct account of successive radioactive transformations, tied to nuclide/element identification and radiation knowledge.
sourceConclusion.unsupportedAsUniversalRequirement: No checked directly mapped clause explicitly establishes time-dependent daughter buildup or a mandatory Bateman model across this current goal scope.
sourceConclusion.inferenceLimit: This is a bounded interpretation of the four directly mapped source lanes, not proof that no curriculum or legitimate optional LK enrichment anywhere covers parent-daughter dynamics. Search terms alone were not used as the basis of the conclusion.
sourceConclusion.sourceMappingLimit: An inherited broad applicability entry must not be mistaken for an exact clause supporting a new advanced competency in all 15 jurisdictions.

neighborAnalysis.currentCompetence: Simple decay law, activity and half-life, qualitative description of chains.
neighborAnalysis.boundary: Basic time decay remains here. The general mention of chain description creates real overlap, but does not already demand an explicit multi-step consistency proof.

neighborAnalysis.currentCompetence: Digital nuclide-chart interpretation, reading nuclide properties and reconstructing chains.
neighborAnalysis.boundary: This is a direct dependent of 3b, not an unrelated topic. Its reconstruction necessarily uses conservation bookkeeping; replacing 3b with the same reconstruction task would be duplicative.
neighborAnalysis.didacticDistinctionPossible: 3b may be the physical validity check of a supplied sequence, while 64b chooses and reads empirical nuclide information to reconstruct a supported chain. A/Z bookkeeping constrains a chain but cannot by itself establish its physical occurrence, branch probabilities or half-lives.
neighborAnalysis.honesty: This is a proposed prerequisite/application distinction, not a proof of zero overlap or a final atomicity approval.

preferredBoundedWording.status: Needs parent adjudication of the prerequisite/application distinction before authoring or image staging.
preferredBoundedWording.description: Die lernende Person kann für eine vorgegebene radioaktive Zerfallsreihe die Änderungen von Massenzahl und Kernladungszahl über die einzelnen Zerfallsschritte bilanzieren und damit die angegebenen Ausgangs-, Zwischen- und Endnuklide auf Konsistenz prüfen.
preferredBoundedWording.descriptionEn: The learner can track changes in mass number and atomic number through the steps of a given radioactive decay chain and use these balances to check the consistency of the stated initial, intermediate, and final nuclides.
preferredBoundedWording.rationale: Names the quantities and the check criterion behind 'berechnen', replacing vague discussion with one assessable physical consistency task. It does not require reconstructing an unknown chart path, deriving time functions, or handling a new advanced formula.
preserved: Current scope and mappings, pending normal explicit revalidation
preferredBoundedWording.limitation: Conservation consistency is necessary, not sufficient, for an actual allowed decay. Tasks must supply or reference known allowed decay modes instead of inviting deductions of physical occurrence from A/Z alone.

alternativesRequiringSeparateAuthority.choice: If prerequisite/application distinction is not sufficiently independent

alternativesRequiringSeparateAuthority.choice: If parent-daughter kinetics is intentionally required as enrichment
alternativesRequiringSeparateAuthority.action: Define a separate, explicitly source/scope-justified competency on the time evolution of a closed, specified decay chain. Do not silently relabel this broad, already-required 3b ID.
alternativesRequiringSeparateAuthority.distinctCompetence: Model production and decay simultaneously, distinguish nuclide populations from activities, supply initial conditions/branching and model assumptions, and interpret the resulting curves.
alternativesRequiringSeparateAuthority.graphImpact: Such dynamics are not a didactic prerequisite for simple chart interpretation; a future graph must not force them before 64b30.
alternativesRequiringSeparateAuthority.notProposedNow: No new goal ID, formula set, source mapping, applicability change or prerequisite rewiring.

correctnessControls.exampleStatus: Illustrative non-operative assessment boundary, not a registered P profile.
correctnessControls.given: In a supplied formal sequence one alpha transformation is followed by two beta-minus transformations, starting with A=238 and Z=92. Gamma transitions, if shown, leave both numbers unchanged.
negative: A beta-minus step reducing mass number is inconsistent.
A gamma step changing the nuclide's mass or atomic number is inconsistent.
The final A/Z balance does not give a daughter population at a specified time.
Correct A/Z balance alone does not establish which possible branches occur or their probabilities.
correctnessControls.calculationMeaning: Integer charge/nucleon bookkeeping across a supplied sequence, not a hidden demand for mother-daughter time functions.
